scripts.download: v=${RAFI_VERSION:-$npm_package_config_rafi_version} && rm -rf worker && mkdir worker && curl -fsSL "${RAFI_RELEASE_URL:-https://github.com/sagikazarmark/rafi/releases/download}/v$v/worker.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C worker
scripts.build: npm run download && mkdir -p worker/worker-assets/legal && cp legal/terms.md legal/privacy.md worker/worker-assets/legal/
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
